title: Conversational creativity is the future of video #shorts
description:
You can now create insane visuals, like this, just by having a conversation.

No buttons, no settings, you don’t even need to know which video models are the best to use.

What you’re looking at is Artlist’s new conversational AI agent.

It’s kinda like having a Creator Director that knows everything about AI, cinematics, and visuals…on staff 24/7.

For example, we had a vision for a lost at sea style scene with me as the main character. 

We described it, but this first vibe was a little too unrealistic and fantasy for what we wanted…

So we thought maybe a pirate vibe would be better, and then ultimately ended up switching to a viking themed scene all with super easy conversational tweaks.

And that's really why this conversational creativity is so powerful.

The reason AI video is so hard is because you have to know what settings to tweak in order to make the vision in your head, a reality.

Now, you can just describe that vision in plain English and Artlist’s creative agent knows exactly how to bring it to life.

But the coolest part about this…is that just like a Creative Director, it actually gives you proactive feedback on what to change.

Because it has memory of your entire conversation, it has creative context…that all other AI video tools are missing.

And this makes a huge difference.

Now we are still in the early days of what this conversational creativity is gonna look like, but this is one of the most powerful creative workflows I’ve tried.
